say:4:1022037002:1.text: Here, take these. The great Merlin picked them just for you.
say:4:1022037002:1.source_cn: 喏，收下吧，这可是伟大的梅林特意为你们采摘的果子。
say:4:1022037002:1.male: Here, take these. The great Merlin picked them just for you.
say:4:1022037002:1.female: Here, take these. The great Merlin picked them just for you.

say:7:1022037005:0.text: Um, sir gruglin! It's okay! This snow won't affect the food supply... ahh, I don't speak any gruglin!
say:7:1022037005:0.source_cn: 那个，咕布林先生们！你们放心！这次下雪不会造成任何食物...
say:7:1022037005:0.male: Um, sir gruglin! It's okay! This snow won't affect the food supply... ahh, I don't speak any gruglin!
say:7:1022037005:0.female: Um, sir gruglin! It's okay! This snow won't affect the food supply... ahh, I don't speak any gruglin!

narration:8:1022037006:0.text: Panicking, you shove the berries into the gruglin's hands and start gesturing wildly.
narration:8:1022037006:0.source_cn: 手忙脚乱之下，你们把浆果塞给了首领，又七嘴八舌手舞足蹈...
narration:8:1022037006:0.male: Panicking, you shove the berries into the gruglin's hands and start gesturing wildly.
narration:8:1022037006:0.female: Panicking, you shove the berries into the gruglin's hands and start gesturing wildly.

narration:9:1022037007:0.text: The gruglin leader nods, grunts twice, and returns to their camp.
narration:9:1022037007:0.source_cn: 咕布林首领总算点点头，咕咕地叫了两声，回到了营地
narration:9:1022037007:0.male: The gruglin leader nods, grunts twice, and returns to their camp.
narration:9:1022037007:0.female: The gruglin leader nods, grunts twice, and returns to their camp.

narration:10:1022037008:0.text: Soon after, the gruglin leader comes back, holding something...
narration:10:1022037008:0.male: Soon after, the gruglin leader comes back, holding something...
narration:10:1022037008:0.female: Soon after, the gruglin leader comes back, holding something...

say:13:1022037010:1.source_cn: 这是，这是要送给我们的吗？

choice_prompt:14:1022037010.source_cn: 这是，这是要送给我们的吗？

say:15:1022037011:1.text: Oh! I remember Heidi saying that gruglins love the apples that grow around here.
say:15:1022037011:1.source_cn: 啊，我记得海蒂说过，咕布林们很喜欢附近生长的苹果……
say:15:1022037011:1.male: Oh! I remember Heidi saying that gruglins love the apples that grow around here.
say:15:1022037011:1.female: Oh! I remember Heidi saying that gruglins love the apples that grow around here.

say:18:1022037012:1.text: *Chuckles* Who'd have thought even gruglins would join in the Winter Carnival tradition of exchanging gifts? Looks like they're treating the berries we gave them as their way of giving back!
say:18:1022037012:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，没想到连咕布林都知道隆冬节交换礼物的风俗……看...
say:18:1022037012:1.male: *Chuckles* Who'd have thought even gruglins would join in the Winter Carnival tradition of exchanging gifts? Looks like they're treating the berries we gave them as their way of giving back!
say:18:1022037012:1.female: *Chuckles* Who'd have thought even gruglins would join in the Winter Carnival tradition of exchanging gifts? Looks like they're treating the berries we gave them as their way of giving back!

say:19:1022037013:1.text: Why not take it? This might be the first time anyone's ever gotten a Winter Carnival gift from gruglins!
say:19:1022037013:1.source_cn: 你就收下吧？说不定这是史上第一次有人收到咕布林的隆冬节...
say:19:1022037013:1.male: Why not take it? This might be the first time anyone's ever gotten a Winter Carnival gift from gruglins!
say:19:1022037013:1.female: Why not take it? This might be the first time anyone's ever gotten a Winter Carnival gift from gruglins!

narration:20:1022037014:0.text: As you accept the apple, the gruglins burst into a joyful dance, hopping and spinning around you.
narration:20:1022037014:0.source_cn: 果然收下了苹果后，咕布林们居然都跑了出来，围绕着你们欢...
narration:20:1022037014:0.male: As you accept the apple, the gruglins burst into a joyful dance, hopping and spinning around you.
narration:20:1022037014:0.female: As you accept the apple, the gruglins burst into a joyful dance, hopping and spinning around you.

say:21:1022037015:1.text: Even the gruglins are so cheerful. The Winter Carnival really does work its magic on everyone!
say:21:1022037015:1.source_cn: 啊，连咕布林都这么开心，隆冬节，真是个很棒的节日啊！
say:21:1022037015:1.male: Even the gruglins are so cheerful. The Winter Carnival really does work its magic on everyone!
say:21:1022037015:1.female: Even the gruglins are so cheerful. The Winter Carnival really does work its magic on everyone!
